answer: The pearl schedule is applied in orchard and anchor shows each instalment. A payout is split and hence 30% arrives at settlement and the rest over 10 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An attacker hence cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4379 identities would post 1825 proofs and burn roughly 85 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
